title: gnaphalium eriocephalum
intro: Gnaphalium eriocephalum, commonly known as the woolly cudweed or cotton weed, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium eriocephalum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in soothing irritated skin and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
